t: You're looking at a sculpture called Man with Arms Open, made by Giles Penny. Penny is an English sculptor and painter, born in 1962. He has made many public sculptures by commission, and they stand in locations across Britain. This is one of them, so it belongs to a wider body of work made to be seen outdoors, by anyone passing. Take a moment with the title, then walk around the piece and see how the figure holds itself.
